mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tdm52_chck_manl WHERE tdm52_chck_manl_id = #{targetId} AND tdm52_company_id = #{companyId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tdm63_chck_insuff_record INNER JOIN tdm54_chck_insuff ON tdm54_chck_insuff_id = tdm63_chck_insuff_id WHERE tdm63_chck_insuff_record_id = #{targetId} AND tdm54_company_id = #{companyId})

SELECT tdm64_chck_evid_extr_id AS chck_evid_extr_id , tdm64_target_id AS target_id , tdm64_system_nm AS system_name , tdm64_doc_no AS doc_no , tdm64_doc_nm AS doc_name , to_char(tdm64_doc_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS doc_date , tdm64_note AS note FROM tdm64_chck_evid_extr WHERE tdm64_target_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY COALESCE(tdm64_doc_no,'') , tdm64_doc_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , tdm64_doc_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm64_chck_evid_extr ( tdm64_chck_evid_extr_id, tdm64_target_id, tdm64_system_nm, tdm64_doc_no, tdm64_doc_nm, tdm64_doc_date, tdm64_note, tdm64_upd_nm, tdm64_upd_date ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{targetId}, #{row.systemName}, #{row.docNo}, #{row.docName}, CAST(#{row.docDate} AS date), #{row.note}, #{updName}, f_sysdate() )
